run_fit_normalizers_cli: run the fit_normalizers script with a config yaml file to compute dataset mean and std
run_fit_norms_with_linref: run fit_norms with a config and linear reference file to fit normalizers with element references
fit_normalizers_for_targets: fit normalizers for specified targets using a training dataset and batch size
create_element_references: create element references from a linear reference file for energy normalization
save_normalizers_checkpoint: save fitted normalizers to a checkpoint file at the specified output path
